input_question: Can you tell me what information from my medical records would still need to be checked?

eligibility_assessment.patient_facing_answer: For your specific study, we will need to check certain information from your medical records to ensure you meet the eligibility criteria. Specifically, we will look into your medical history, including any previous sleep studies, dietary habits, and any treatments for your sleep disorder. Additionally, we will review your medical records from your pulmonary doctor to gather information about your sleep study results.

the results of your sleep study

eligibility_assessment.safety_note: Taking part in this study is completely voluntary. You may choose not to take part at all. If you decide to be in this study, you may stop participating at any time. If you decide not to be in this study, or if you stop participating at any time, you won't be penalized or lose any benefits for which you otherwise qualify.

study_purpose.text: This study aims to gather information about bladder cancer patients' health and treatments.

who_may_join.text: The study includes bladder cancer patients aged 30-79 who were newly diagnosed with bladder carcinoma, including carcinoma in situ, but not those diagnosed after 2003.

procedures_or_participation.text: Participants will be interviewed about their physical activity, receive medical evaluations, and provide information about their health conditions and treatments.

risks_or_burdens.text: There are no specific risks mentioned. Participants may need to undergo medical evaluations and provide personal information.

time_commitment.text: The study involves several visits and tasks, but the exact time commitment is not specified.
